headline: Conserved structured ncRNA motifs and sRNA target atlases emerge across species
label: Noncoding Rna Structure And Resources
summary: Recent preprints extend comparative ncRNA annotation to protists and Staphylococcus aureus, with an integrated sRNA target database.
synthesis: The common thread is computational analysis of RNA sequence and structure. Two preprints apply comparative and integrative methods. A comparative genomics screen using CMfinder and R-scape identifies seven candidate structured ncRNA motifs across protist genomes, with covariation-based support. aureoRNA combines phylogeny, public transcriptomes, and computational predictions into an interactive atlas of S. aureus sRNAs and their targets. What is new is the covariation-based motif screening in protists and the integration of target predictions with public expression data in a reusable S. aureus resource. The other two items are not resources. A Cell study reports that RNA folding drives species-dependent partitioning of host mRNAs into Ebola virus condensates. A Bioinformatics study models how promoter choice shapes 5' UTR-mediated translation in E. coli, introducing UTR Designer Pro. Preprint findings remain provisional.
